title: Animation panel cannot make new RESET track.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: Godot 4.6 stable release

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable (89cea1439) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6603) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.79 GiB memory

### Issue description

**Issue:**
When interacting with an animation player that does not already have a RESET track, right-clicking a track in the animation editor does not provide an option for creating a RESET value, the "Add tracks to RESET" option under the "Edit" menu is grayed out and adding a shortcut to it doesn't enable it or otherwise bypass the inability to click it, and adding new animation tracks does not prompt the creation of a RESET value. Animation players that already have a RESET track are able to use the "Add tracks to RESET" button under "Edit." I know of no other means to add a RESET track.

**How I expected it to work:**
Right-clicking a track presents an option to add a RESET value, and adding a new track to an animation should prompt the creation of a RESET track, based on the behavior of the Godot 4.5 build.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Export rigged model from Blender as glb/gltf
2. Import gltf into Godot
3. Open model as "new inherited scene", save scene
4. Create new CharacterBody3D scene, instantiate the inherited scene as a child of the CharacterBody3D with "editable children" enabled
5. Select the AnimationPlayer, open Animation Tools in the Animation editor, and create a new animation library or load an existing one
6. In the new library, add a new animation
7. In the new animation, add a new keyframe to any value [if the problem is reproduced, this does not prompt the user to add a RESET track, unlike in 4.5]
8. Right-click the keyframe [if the problem is reproduced, this does not provide an option to add a RESET track, unlike in 4.5]
9. Click the Edit menu, scroll down to "add tracks to RESET", and attempt to click or otherwise activate it [this does not work due to no RESET animation existing at the time]

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[reset-animation-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24949079/reset-animation-test.zip)
